patch_reason: vLLM 0.28.0 maps MIG UUIDs through NVML physical indices, which fails for the second through fourth MIG instances; its non-NVML path also rejects MIG string IDs without the second patch.
isolation_note: Four MIG instances started successfully; idle versus busy profiling measured a 10% higher cold-prefill slope and about 3% higher decode-step fit under heavy neighbor load.
